decision: Run 8 workers at 896 MiB next, before the 6-worker fallback, to test whether lower heap changes full-batch throughput.
decision_constraints: The censored 8-worker/1024 MiB attempt remains only a slower-than-reference lower bound, not a completed makespan.
A candidate more than 5% slower or censored triggers fresh matched incumbent/candidate batches before confirming loss or stopping that direction.
After confirmed loss or failure at 8 workers, try 6 workers at the best successful heap.
Report only the best tested complete configuration; do not claim a global or absolute minimum.
